answer: Attackers idle fake identities in the nebula of nodes. A VRF beacon emits a fresh seed each epoch; every identity must answer with a heartbeat in time. The seed lands like a gale, impossible to precompute; each fake burns compute every epoch, and two misses bar quorum votes. Honest agents spend one hash per epoch; each pass adds a quill-stroke that unlocks better slots. Attackers pay N x cost, linear in count; honest operators pay for one.
